items.claim: Liu K has more proven experience and better credentials than Gore.
items.quote: he's got backlash. He's a little more proven.

items.claim: Kelvin Gastelum looks done in his career.
items.quote: Kelvin also looks done for the record.

items.claim: Gore's record has flaws, including four losses in ten pro fights and getting taken down twice by Marco Tulio.
items.quote: a guy with 10 pro fights, four losses, like Gore's record's not that that great. Got taken down twice by Marco Tulio.

items.claim: Vicente Luque showed the ability to land offensive takedowns and succeed over five rounds in the RDA fight.
items.quote: Vicente Lucas showed us a different wrinkle of his game there where he was able to get offensive takedowns and had a lot of success over the course of five rounds.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is long and rangy with nasty leg kicks.
items.quote: his best part of his game is that he's long and rangy, but he's got nasty leg kicks.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando struggles with defensive wrestling against power wrestlers.
items.quote: He can strike. He's not exactly the best defensive wrestler.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias has poor fight IQ, struggles to implement takedowns timely, and takes too much damage.
items.quote: the fight IQ. It's like non-existent... He takes way too much damage and then he starts to shoot the takedowns.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias is very young and still looks green in his performances.
items.quote: he's super young... outside of getting a a first round sub... everything else I've watched from him is just like he looks pretty green
